# ModifyGadgetItem <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ModifyGadgetItem:Void gadget:Int32, index:Int32, item:String, icon:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a list box, combo box or tabber. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Number of the entry, starting at 0. |
| `item` | In | String | required | The new text. |
| `icon` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Number of an icon of the gadget. Defaults to -1, which means none. |

## Description

Changes the text of an entry.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Modify", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
list = CreateListBox(10, 10, 200, 100, win)
AddGadgetItem list, "Old name"
ModifyGadgetItem list, 0, "New name"
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
